title: Customer requests completed security questionnaire, sample SIEM export, and ELK field-mapping guide for legal review
text:
Customer requests completed security questionnaire, sample SIEM export, and ELK field-mapping guide for legal review

description:
Issue summary:
BrightBank (enterprise) sent a security questionnaire as part of an annual vendor review. They requested a completed questionnaire PDF plus: (1) a sample 7-day SIEM export (parquet or gzipped JSON) showing redwood audit events scoped to their tenant, (2) a field-mapping guide for ingesting into Elastic (ELK) including sample Logstash config, and (3) a signed manifest or HMAC proving integrity of the sample bundle for legal review.

Impact:
- Customer legal/compliance cannot finalize vendor approval until evidence is provided.
- Potential procurement delays if not delivered within 5 business days.

Environment:
- Production (us-east) tenant: brightbank-prod-01
- Platform components in-scope: audit-export pipeline, S3 archival, audit-service signing, SIEM connectors.

Customer asks / Deliverables requested:
1) Completed security questionnaire PDF (answers inline, with references to artifacts).
2) 7-day sample SIEM export scoped to tenant (gzip JSON and parquet), time window: 2026-02-18 to 2026-02-24.
3) Signed manifest: SHA256 checksums of each file + HMAC-SHA256 over manifest using rotation key with key-id.
4) ELK field-mapping guide: mapping document that maps Redwood audit fields to common ECS fields, plus example Logstash config and sample Kibana index pattern.
5) Short runbook describing how to request full historical export on legal subpoena (who to contact, estimated lead times).

Attachments provided by customer:
- brightbank_vendor_questionnaire_v3.xlsx (uploaded to ticket)
- contact for legal questions: legal-requests@brightbank.com

Notes/constraints:
- Customer requested that sample logs exclude any PII; they explicitly asked for redaction before export.
- They requested manifest be verifiable in case of downstream chain-of-custody checks.


comments:
2026-02-28 10:14 — Aisha Patel (Support): Acknowledged request. Assigned to Marco (SRE/Exports). First response ETA: 2026-03-01. Escalated to Compliance for questionnaire answers.
2026-03-01 09:02 — Marco Ruiz (SRE): Investigating feasibility for producing tenant-scoped export and signed manifest. Hypothesis: use ad-hoc export job from audit-archive with redaction pipeline (PII scrub) + downstream signer. Need approval from Compliance to include hash key id in manifest. Requesting list of top-5 event types customer cares about (suggest: auth.login, api.request, model.infer, config.change, admin.role_change).
2026-03-01 11:30 — BrightBank (Customer): Confirmed top event types: auth.login, api.request, model.infer. PII redaction required: user.email, request.payload.user_message. We prefer gzip JSON and parquet if possible. Legal contact provided.
2026-03-02 15:45 — Compliance (Grace Huang): Provided approved language for questionnaire answers. Approved disclosure for audit export: we can provide tenant-scoped, redacted exports and an HMAC-signed manifest generated with key-id rk-2024-rot1. Forwarding template for completed questionnaire.
2026-03-03 08:20 — Marco Ruiz (SRE): Generated sample export: brightbank_sample_20260218-20260224.json.gz (20MB) and brightbank_sample_20260218-20260224.parquet (6MB). Applied PII redaction pipeline v2 (removed user.email, masked user_id). Created manifest and HMAC via signing service. Uploaded bundle to pre-auth S3 share and shared one-time link with customer. Attached ELK field mapping and Logstash example.
2026-03-04 09:10 — BrightBank (Customer): Confirming receipt of bundle and questionnaire draft. Noted minor mapping question about 'actor.identity' vs 'user.name'. Asked if we can provide a short explanation for the masking approach used on user identifiers for their legal team.
2026-03-04 15:55 — Marco Ruiz (SRE): Clarified: we mask user_id with irreversible prefix-hash plus per-tenant salt; actor.identity maps to ecs.user.id and user.name is mapped when present. Updated mapping doc to include masking note and added explicit example. Delivered final PDF of completed questionnaire and the signed manifest (HMAC key-id rk-2024-rot1).
2026-03-05 11:02 — BrightBank (Customer): Thanks — legal has everything needed. Marking as resolved on their side. Follow-up: they may request a notarized chain-of-custody for future subpoena; routed contact to Support/Compliance.

resolution:
Delivered redacted 7-day SIEM sample in gzip JSON and parquet, provided HMAC-signed manifest (key-id rk-2024-rot1), delivered ELK field-mapping guide and Logstash example, and returned completed security questionnaire PDF. Customer confirmed legal acceptance.
